list.query: SELECT id as __value, razon_social as __text FROM contratistas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY razon_social

list.name: area
list.label: Área
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM areas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

targets.rawSql: SELECT pg_size_pretty(SUM(tamano_bytes)::bigint) AS total_almacenamiento, COUNT(*) AS total_documentos FROM documentos WHERE estado_activo = true
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM documentos WHERE estado_activo = true
SELECT pg_size_pretty(AVG(tamano_bytes)::bigint) AS promedio FROM documentos WHERE estado_activo = true
SELECT date_trunc('month', fecha_upload) AS time, SUM(tamano_bytes) / 1048576.0 AS value FROM documentos WHERE estado_activo = true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT tipo_mime, COUNT(*) AS total FROM documentos WHERE estado_activo = true GROUP BY tipo_mime ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT d.nombre_archivo, pg_size_pretty(d.tamano_bytes::bigint) AS tamano, d.tipo_mime, e.titulo AS expediente FROM documentos d JOIN expedientes e ON d.expediente_id = e.id WHERE d.estado_activo = true ORDER BY d.tamano_bytes DESC LIMIT 10
